recipes.measurementPython:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, json, hashlib, re, statistics, platform, os, time, tempfile, types
root=Path('/tmp/starshine-a4237ca-review')
tools={
 'baseline':'/tmp/starshine-a4237ca-baseline/_build/native/release/build/cmd/cmd.exe',
 'candidate':'/home/dev/Projects/starshine-mb/_build/native/release/build/cmd/cmd.exe',
 'binaryen':'/home/dev/.local/share/mise/installs/github-web-assembly-binaryen/ersion_133/bin/wasm-opt',
}
validator='/home/dev/.local/share/mise/installs/wasm-tools/1.262.0/wasm-tools-1.262.0-x86_64-linux/wasm-tools'
identities={k:{'path':v,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(v).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':Path(v).stat().st_size} for k,v in tools.items()}
rows=[]
for kind in ['merge-locals','dae2']:
 inp=root/('merge-locals-dense.wasm' if kind=='merge-locals' else 'dae2-type-scan.wasm')
 for round_no in range(-2,11):
  order=['baseline','candidate','binaryen'] if round_no%2==0 else ['binaryen','candidate','baseline']
  for name in order:
   out=root/f'{kind}-{name}.wasm'; resource=root/'resource.txt'
   args=[tools[name],str(inp),'--'+kind,'-o',str(out)]
   env=os.environ.copy()
   if name=='binaryen': args+=['--all-features'];env['BINARYEN_PASS_DEBUG']='1'
   else: args+=['--tracing=pass']
   start=time.perf_counter()
   with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode='w+') as stdout, tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode='w+') as stderr:
    child=subprocess.Popen([str(root/'rss-child'),str(resource),*args],stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,env=env)
    _,status,usage=os.wait4(child.pid,0)
    child.returncode=os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
    stdout.seek(0);stderr.seek(0)
    proc=types.SimpleNamespace(returncode=child.returncode,stdout=stdout.read(),stderr=stderr.read())
   wall=time.perf_counter()-start
   (root/f'{kind}-{name}-{round_no}.stderr').write_text(proc.stderr)
   timers={m.group(1):int(m.group(2)) for m in re.finditer(r'perf:timer name=(\S+) elapsed_us=(\d+)',proc.stderr)}
   oracle=re.search(r'running pass: '+re.escape(kind)+r'\.\.\. ([0-9.eE+-]+) seconds',proc.stderr)
   if proc.returncode: raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr)
   rss=int(resource.read_text().strip())
   rows.append({'pass':kind,'round':round_no,'tool':name,'wall_seconds':wall,'timers_us':timers,'binaryen_pass_us':float(oracle.group(1))*1e6 if oracle else None,'max_rss_kib':int(rss),'stderr':proc.stderr,'bytes':out.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
 for name in tools:
  subgroup=[r for r in rows if r['pass']==kind and r['tool']==name]
  assert len({r['sha256'] for r in subgroup})==1, 'output drift'
  subprocess.run([validator,'validate','--features','all',str(root/f'{kind}-{name}.wasm')],check=True)
  if name!='binaryen':
   plain=root/f'{kind}-{name}-plain.wasm'
   subprocess.run([tools[name],str(inp),'--'+kind,'-o',str(plain)],check=True,capture_output=True)
   assert hashlib.sha256(plain.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==subgroup[0]['sha256'], 'trace changes output'
record={'baseline_commit':'a4237ca0336d665137622490ffe6f348f6e49176','candidate_source_diff_sha256':hashlib.sha256(subprocess.run(['git','diff','--binary','a4237ca0336d665137622490ffe6f348f6e49176','--','src'],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout).hexdigest(),'inputs':{p.name:{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size} for p in [root/'merge-locals-dense.wasm',root/'dae2-type-scan.wasm']},'environment':{'platform':platform.platform(),'cpu_count':os.cpu_count(),'compiler':subprocess.run(['cc','--version'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()[0],'moon':subprocess.run(['moon','version','--all'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout},'identities':identities,'samples':rows}
(root/'measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
for kind in ['merge-locals','dae2']:
 for name in tools:
  group=[r for r in rows if r['pass']==kind and r['tool']==name and r['round']>=0]
  print(kind,name,'wall median',statistics.median(r['wall_seconds'] for r in group),'rss median',statistics.median(r['max_rss_kib'] for r in group),'bytes',group[0]['bytes'])
